text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"How's that!
With this all-out run—"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Did you get the message now?!
Our pride! Our determination!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Against the crimson champion,
Furioso unleashed everything he had.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Even we—have a weapon.
The single weapon the Central never has.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
As long as we keep this "frustration" burning,
one day, without a doubt!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Frustration.
That was precisely what fueled them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Funabashi, falling short of the Central.
A fierce desire to overturn that someday.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Ms. Crimson Nova.
...I'm Furioso, from Funabashi."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"You probably don't know me,
but I know you very well."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
You are... strong.
But the local circuits—and Funabashi—have our pride too.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: "I made it this far by channeling the frustration of being utterly crushed by you at the Diolite Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I'll make you take notice.
Of Funabashi, and of me!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Next, I shall challenge the Tokyo Daishoten.
And then, one day—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: I will defeat you at the Diolite Kinen in my hometown of Funabashi.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
When I managed to defeat you
on the very same stage as that day—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
With that, at last—
Our curse will finally be broken.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furioso revealed for the first time her desire for revenge
in the fated Diolite Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed Furioso had been thinking about that all along.
After all, a tragedy born in Funabashi
can only truly be laid to rest in Funabashi...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"To you, I may just be an Umamusume
not worth paying mind to. Even so..."

text_block_list.name: Crimson Nova
text_block_list.text: I am—paying attention to it.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Crimson Nova
text_block_list.text:
I'm keeping an eye on them, yes. Furioso of Funabashi.
And—

text_block_list.name: Crimson Nova
text_block_list.text:
"Nor am I underestimating them.
As the one accepting the challenge, all I have is—"

text_block_list.name: Crimson Nova
text_block_list.text: It's a different feeling.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: A different... feeling?

text_block_list.name: Crimson Nova
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed. We, too, harbor feelings
that you could not possibly fathom."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Leaving those words behind, Crimson Nova turned her back and walked away."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The same day, night—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you said you were aware of it...
but is that really true?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I thought I wouldn't even pay mind to
an Umamusume from Funabashi, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Crimson Nova had certainly acted cold until now.
However—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It might not be completely out of mind.
And besides...
choice_data_list: I wonder what kind of "other feelings" they mean?
I wonder what kind of "other feelings" they mean?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed. I wonder what feelings she's running with.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
The Diolite Kinen, which was a one-sided game.
And the two races where we competed against each other...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Whenever she runs against regional Umamusume,
what must she be feeling deep down...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The central league would never understand our inferiority complex.
And just the same—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Central might have something of their own that we don't understand.
In any case—
choice_data_list: The next race is the final one of the year. Let's do our best!
The next race is the final one this year. Let's do our best!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
The final race of the three-race stretch—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"The Tokyo Daishoten! I'll put on a race that I can be proud of
as the culmination of this whole year!"
